{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse, relaxed fit, mid-thigh length, soft beige (#F5F5DC), lightweight woven silk.
Charcoal wool-blend trousers, straight leg, ankle length, deep gray (#36454F), heavy wool with a fine merino blend.
Structured charcoal blazer, cropped waist length, open front, dark charcoal (#2F3741), textured bouclé weave.
Black leather loafers, low heel, rounded toe, glossy black (#000000), smooth full-grain leather.
Gold-tone minimalist pendant necklace, 16-inch chain, polished gold, sterling silver over brass.

This outfit adheres strictly to the "neat" dress code required for a daily office environment while respecting your refusal of overly formal or casual items. The wool-blend trousers provide warmth suitable for autumn weather, and the structured blazer adds a polished professional layer without looking stiff. Choosing neutral tones like cream, charcoal, and black ensures versatility for various office settings, while the gold jewelry introduces a subtle personal touch that balances the seriousness of the workwear."}
